# Pescobar Seafood Bruxelles

> Restaurant in Brussels (Avenue Louise & Saint-Gilles / Louizalaan / Luiza) specializing in sharing Seafood Boil platters, whole grilled octopus, Mediterranean fish & shellfish, and weekday Business Lunch.

## Brand & Legal Entity
- **Brand Name:** Pescobar Seafood Bruxelles
- **Legal Entity:** Pescobar Seafood Brussels SRL
- **BCE / VAT Number:** BE 1022.567.070
- **Registered Office:** Avenue Louise 209/A/7, 1050 Ixelles (Bruxelles), Belgique
- **Languages Spoken:** French (`fr`), Dutch (`nl`), English (`en`), Romanian (`ro`)

## Location & Access
- **Restaurant Address:** Rue Jourdan 18, 1060 Saint-Gilles, Brussels, Belgium (150 m from Avenue Louise & Place Stéphanie)
- **Nearest Metro:** Louise (Lines 2 & 6 — approx. 3 min walk / 250 m via Goulet Louise)
- **Tram Stops:** Stéphanie / Louise (Trams 8, 92, 93, 97 — approx. 2 min walk)
- **Nearby Parking:** Interparking Stéphanie-Louise (Avenue Louise 83), Interparking Toison d'Or (Avenue de la Toison d'Or 20), Parking Poelaert (Place Poelaert)
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pescobar+Seafood+Brussels+Rue+Jourdan+18+1060+Saint-Gilles

## Opening Hours
- **Restaurant (Daily):** 12:00 – 23:00 (Monday to Sunday; kitchen closes at 22:30)
- **Business Lunch (Weekdays):** 12:00 – 15:00 (Monday to Friday)

## Contact & Reservations
- **Phone:** +32 499 00 70 22
- **WhatsApp:** +32 499 00 70 22
- **Email:** pescobarseafoodbrussels@gmail.com
- **Delivery & Takeaway:**
  - Dedicated Guide: https://pescobarseafoodbruxelles.be/fr/delivery
  - Uber Eats: https://www.ubereats.com/be/store/pescobar-seafood-brussels/OS1Nzd9EXuOVstxPV2FdAg
  - Deliveroo: https://deliveroo.be/nl-be/menu/brussels/st-gilles/pescobar-seafood-brussels
  - Takeaway.com: https://www.takeaway.com/be-fr/menu/pescobar-seafood-brussels-bruxelles
  - Direct Pickup (0% fees): Rue Jourdan 18, 1060 Saint-Gilles (+32 499 00 70 22)

## Signature Menu Highlights
- **Pescobar Seafood Boil Platter (5–6 people):** 130 €
- **Gigant Platter "Top of the World" by Pescobar (4–6 persons, 5000g, includes 1 bottle Aerosoli White/Rosé):** 184 €
- **Whole Grilled Octopus (950g, includes 1 bottle Aerosoli White/Rosé):** 134 €
- **Business Lunch Formulas (Monday–Friday, 12:00–15:00):** Seafood Soup + choice of Fish & Chips, Grilled Shrimp with Rice, Seafood Pan, or Seafood Paella
- **Allergen & Nutrition Information:** Full EU 14-allergen disclosure and per-100g nutrition notes available on the menu.
